observation.owner_words: 没有弹出信任窗口，诊断页没了，小部件还是白色
observation.notes: On this image the kernel boot page no longer appears although it is built with boot-progress=2 (keeps drawing), and the desktop widgets stayed white after wallpaper-freeze=1 was removed. Both are consistent with the panel fetching the compositor surface directly (dpu-scanout=2): NativeLegacyDisplay.cpp:365-374 rewrites the SSPP source address and flushes the CTL, so the boot framebuffer the page draws into is no longer scanned.

timeline.a650-b_3f488107: gpu-addon=1 only: desktop rendered correctly, gpu offers=2871, 22 ms CPU copy per frame
timeline.a650-d_95169672: adds dpu-scanout=2 wallpaper-freeze=1: scrolling smoother, widgets start rendering white
timeline.usb-scan-a_6c0b77a4: same display arguments plus the USB fix: widgets still white, boot page no longer on the panel
timeline.usb-scan-b_e431e7e3: wallpaper-freeze removed, dpu-scanout kept: widgets still white, boot page still absent

next_test: usb-scan-c 1f01649e removes dpu-scanout entirely (GPU full-frame copy): expect the boot page back and the widgets drawn, which confirms the direct scanout path as the cause.
